chatterbox.name: Chatterbox Multilingual
chatterbox.languages: 23: ar da de el en es fi fr he hi it ja ko ms nl no pl pt ru sv sw tr zh
chatterbox.voices: one default voice; zero-shot cloning from a short reference clip
chatterbox.parameters: exaggeration 0.5 (emotion intensity), cfg_weight 0.5 (pacing and adherence), temperature 0.8, repetition_penalty 2.0, min_p 0.05, top_p 1.0
chatterbox.special: Embeds Resemble's Perth imperceptible watermark in every output (an extra AI marker); emotion intensity is a single knob; ran on the Apple GPU (MPS).

xtts.name: XTTS-v2
xtts.maker: Coqui (community fork coqui-tts; weights from the tts-hub/XTTS-v2 mirror)
xtts.licence: Coqui Public Model License: non-commercial only
xtts.languages: 17: en es fr de it pt pl tr ru nl cs ar zh-cn hu ko ja hi
xtts.voices: 57 built-in studio speakers; cloning from about 6 seconds of reference audio
xtts.parameters: temperature 0.75, top_k 50, top_p 0.85, repetition_penalty 5.0, length_penalty 1.0, speed
xtts.special: Fastest here (faster than real time on the CPU); streaming output; a cloned voice can speak other languages.

dia.name: Dia 1.6B
dia.voices: random per run unless seeded or given an audio prompt (cloning)
dia.special: Writes a whole two-speaker dialogue in one pass from [S1]/[S2] tags; non-verbal sounds such as (laughs), (sighs), (coughs) in the text.
dia.ran_as: the dialogue in one pass with a fixed seed
